description: This file defines a Flutter UI screen for displaying user appointments. It contains code for fetching appointment data via Riverpod providers, rendering the appointments in a list, and showing placeholders for empty or loading states.

classes.name: AppointmentsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a list of user appointments, fetched asynchronously using Riverpod providers, with UI elements for viewing, empty state, loading, and creating new appointments.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the appointments screen UI, including app bar, appointment list or placeholders, and a floating button for new appointments.
